blocks.text: Silver Valley homes listed and sold, June to October 2026

Silver Valley, October 2026. Detached houses: 46 listed at month end and 5 sold in October, a sales ratio of 11% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 13 listed at month end and 2 sold in October, a sales ratio of 15% (a balanced market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 34 sold over 5 months against an average of 53.2 listed, about 7.8 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 13 sold. Condos and townhomes: 12 sold over 5 months against an average of 13.2 listed, about 5.5 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 5 sold.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Silver Valley?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 46 houses listed with 5 sold in the month and 13 condos and townhomes listed with 2 sold in the month in Silver Valley. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Silver Valley a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 11%, a buyers’ market; condos and townhomes had a sales ratio of 15%, a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
